sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
8.3.3.3 Any change to a characteristic designated special, to its control method or to its sampling frequency needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.

findings.why: Cutting the tensile test from 1 specimen per heat to 1 per 3 heats changes the sampling frequency of special characteristic SC-01. CSR-STL-2026-02 8.3.3.3 requires written Stellantis approval before implementation, and no approval in the documents covers it. The documents do not state which Annex A program BR-220 belongs to, so confirm that BR-220 is delivered to Stellantis for STL-Torino-27 or STL-Torino-31. The 'no tensile failure so far' argument does not replace the approval.
